thread.title: Netflix Shares Trading at Record High

author: Barron's
title: Netflix Shares Trading at Record High

organizations.name: netflix shares trading at record high getty images netflix

text:
Getty Images Netflix ( NFLX ) shares just cracked $400 Tuesday, a record intraday price, and at least two research firms see the shares going even higher.
GBH Insights and Piper Jaffray significantly raised price targets on the video-streaming service today, with bullish reports on Netflix's content and distribution prospects over the next 12 to 18 months.
GBH increased its price target to $500 from $400, a 28% upside to the company's closing stock price on Monday. That is the highest target among the 36 analysts who cover the streaming-media service, according to FactSet . The firm reiterated a "Highly Attractive" rating.
Netflix's "competitive moat, franchise appeal, ability to increase international streaming customers through 2020, and original content build out will translate into robust profitability and growth," Daniel Ives , head of technology research at GBH, wrote in a note to clients.
Meanwhile, Piper Jaffray's Michael Olson , in raising the price target to $420 from $367, predicted strong international subscription growth for Netflix and maintained an Outperform rating. Olson forecasts second-quarter growth of 40.9% year-over-year and its index points to 48.7% growth.
Netflix shares are up more than 2% today, to $399.53, and have doubled so far this year. The company's success in video-streaming, and its continued aggressive spending on original content, has prompted everyone from Amazon.com ( AMZN ) and Apple ( AAPL ) to Walt Disney ( DIS ) and Comcast ( CMCSA ) to scramble to catch up.
